items.Description: A pickaxe, generally used by miners and the like in clearing away rock and breaking apart stone or masonry. Also employed in the mining of gems.

items.Name: Common Plate
items.Description: A common plate for eating from, made from a brittle ceramic. This is a simple eating surface, suitable for internal or external use.

items.Name: Common Quill
items.Description: A common quill fashioned from a feather, the end sharpened and tipped to provide a point with which to write accurately when dipped lightly in ink. The most common method of scribing scrolls, letters, notes and the like use the common quill.

items.Name: Common Scabbard
items.Description: Scabbards are the sheaths for swords when not in use, and commonly attach to the belt to lie comfortably at the wearer's side, or in the case of larger swords can be swung across the back to facilitate drawing a weapon from behind the back or overhead.

items.Name: Brass Measuring Scales

items.Description: A non human skull that extends into an elongated, bird-like beak at the mandible. This skull is fairly heavy in the hand, and is a little larger than an adult human equivalent skull.

items.Name: Common Spade
items.Description: A common spade, generally used in external areas to dig holes in the ground. A strong iron flat head is supported by a thick wooden shaft, and this spade is of a sturdy design.
